answer: One concrete sybil defense is topology-aware gossip admission: each peer forwards new agent identities and attestations only from a bounded set of randomly assigned long-lived neighbors, and an identity earns forwarding priority only after it has been seen from at least k distinct network regions. Because messages propagate like a river through the graph, a sybil cluster that appears suddenly travels like a comet, bright but short lived, since it lacks the slow accumulation of region-diverse sightings that honest nodes gain like a steady zephyr over weeks of presence.
